scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && vite build
scripts.start: concurrently --names "dev,ws,queue,schedule" --prefix-colors "green,cyan,magenta,blue" "npm run dev" "php artisan reverb:start" "php artisan queue:work -q" "php artisan schedule:work"
scripts.types: php artisan scramble:clear && php artisan scramble:export --path=frontend/src/api/api.json && node frontend/scripts/patch-schema.js && npm run types -w frontend
scripts.pull: git stash && git pull && git stash apply
scripts.resetdb: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed && php artisan actions:sync && npm run loadtestfactory
scripts.compileagent:php: php -l public/agents/php_agent/agent.txt && echo PHP agent syntax OK
scripts.compileagent:cs: dotnet publish public/agents/cs_agent/MonitorAgent/MonitorAgent.csproj -c Release -o public/agents/cs_agent --self-contained true -r win-x64 -p:PublishSingleFile=true
scripts.compileagent: npm run compileagent:php && npm run compileagent:cs
